Definition: from G2596 and G3506; to nod down (towards), i.e. (by analogy) to make signs to:--beckon.
BiblicalUsage: They beckoned to their partners in the other ship to come and help them, and both ships began to sink with the catch.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the beckon is the moment a good catch becomes too much for one boat, and the call for help is part of the miracle.
